muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events sse(Stream(ctx, lastEventID, send))" -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Stream resumes from a typed Last-Event-Id: the header parses to int before
// the stream opens, so a bad value responds 400 with no stream bytes.
func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context, lastEventID int, send func(int) error) {
	_ = send(lastEventID + 1)
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("typed header parses and resumes", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events", nil)
		req.Header.Set("Last-Event-Id", "9")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "data: 10\n\n"; !strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	t.Run("non-numeric header is 400 before the stream opens", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events", nil)
		req.Header.Set("Last-Event-Id", "abc")
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
		if strings.Contains(rec.Body.String(), "data:") {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want no stream bytes", rec.Body.String())
		}
		if ct := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"); ct == "text/event-stream" {
			t.Errorf("content-type = %q; the stream must not have been established", ct)
		}
	})
}
